archiveTake: An amazing pick if you want something you can get completely obsessed with.
spoilerFreeReview: Impact Winter unexpectedly became one of my all-time favorites. It started out somewhat slow, but by episode 6 it had me HOOKED. I couldn't stop listening because I HAD to know what happened next. It really grabs you by the throat and doesn't let go.
Season 1 was amazing, though I do feel like the show tapers off as it goes on. By season 3, I felt like it had lost some of what made season 1 so great.
At one point I had listened to season 1 so many times that I could recite entire episodes by heart. Its atmosphere, its world-building, its character development, something just clicked for me.

There are definitely moments and choices I don't love, but they barely change how I feel about the show as a whole. Impact Winter is still one of the easiest audio dramas for me to recommend, because few others have pulled me in this hard.
thoughts: I genuinely don't know why this show clicked with me as hard as it did. I've listened to season 1 more times than almost anything else, and I still find myself wanting to go back to it.
It isn't perfect, and later seasons don't hit quite the same for me, but very few shows have ever gotten their hooks into me like Impact Winter did.

quote.text: You make the choices you can live with.
